their_evidence: The stage sums up the whole of S7 (Sousa joins in S7#4, the two fall for each other) on The End Is at Hand (S7#12), where little passes between them beyond escaping the Chronicom ship. question: The pair's first stage starts at Luke Cage S1#3, but on screen they already deal with each other in S1#1 (Luke works as his dishwasher, fills in at the bar, turns down his job offer) and S1#2 (Luke brings Pop's parley offer and is fired from the club). their_evidence: Moment of Truth: Luke works as a dishwasher at Harlem's Paradise and Cottonmouth offers him a job; Code of the Streets: Luke brings the parley and Cottonmouth fires him; Who's Gonna Take the Weight?: Cottonmouth warns Luke off, Luke raids his stashes, Cottonmouth fires a missile at the restaurant.
